name: Checkbox
description: Native checkbox with a drawn box, check mark and indeterminate state.
whenToUse: Choices submitted with a form (terms, preferences saved with a Save button).
Selecting several items in a list or table, with an indeterminate select-all.
whenNotToUse: Settings that apply instantly — use Switch.
Picking exactly one option — use Radio.

classes.ayy-checkbox: On <input type="checkbox">. Draws the box and mark; size follows density.

states.:indeterminate: Mixed — set input.indeterminate = true (React: indeterminate prop).

a11y: Wrap it in a <label class="ayy-label"> with the text, or pair with <label for>.
Group related checkboxes in a <fieldset> with a <legend>.
do: Phrase labels positively: "Email me updates", not "Don't email me".
dont: Don't use a checkbox to trigger an immediate action.
